name: Suicides
overview: Scripture affirms the value of life as a gift from God, emphasizing that believers are called to live and proclaim His works rather than succumb to death prematurely, as seen in Psalms 118:17. Jesus reminds us that God’s angels are charged with our protection (Luke 4:10), underscoring the divine care over our lives. Furthermore, Christ contrasts the destructive intentions of the thief with His purpose to give abundant life (John 10:10), encouraging believers to embrace the life God offers rather than choosing death.
